'''Inath''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual hailing from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]].<ref name="SWE" /> He was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]]<ref name="AGSWU3" /> and a member of the [[New Republic Ruling Council]]<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="Council" /> in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="11 ABY">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' mentions that [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] when Inath, a member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[New Republic Ruling Council|Council]], pressured her to retire her [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]. According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', Organa Solo became Chief of State in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. Additionally, ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'', which takes place in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] per ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', mentions that several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] had passed since, in the face of mounting pressure from the Council, Organa Solo had disposed of her Noghri bodyguards.</ref>

==Biography==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], Inath of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] saw many of his associates [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Noghri Death Commando]]s.<ref name="SWE" /> At some point after the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|establishment]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> he became a New Republic [[Senator/Legends|senator]].<ref name="AGSWU3" /> 

When [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was [[New Republic Presidential election, 11 ABY|elected]] [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> Inath was a member of the [[New Republic Ruling Council]],<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="Council" /> and among those who pressured her to retire her [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]].<ref name="PoT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref><ref name="SWE" />

The Noghri's [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] to their ''[[Mal'ary'ush]]'' had become an evident [[Politics/Legends|political]] problem for Organa Solo within [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the [[Assault on Mount Tantiss|assault]] on [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]],<ref name="TJAS">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref> in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Several [[Species/Legends|species]] that had once been [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] were opposed to her relationship with the Noghri, including the [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] representative to the New Republic who went so far as to call Organa Solo a "[[Slaver/Legends|slaver]]."<ref name="TJAS" />

Inath claimed that keeping the Noghri bodyguards sent the wrong signal,<ref name="SWE" /> as they had been a weapon used by Emperor Palpatine.<ref name="PoT" /> [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] also gently pressured Organa Solo for [[Standard month/Legends|months]] to cut her ties with the Noghri.<ref name="TJAS" />

Eventually, in the face of mounting pressure from the New Republic Ruling Council,<ref name="PoT" /><ref name="Council" /> and following an unfortunate incident involving her overzealous Noghri bodyguard [[Ahk'laht]] and an [[Unidentified Barabel ambassador|angry]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]],<ref name="TJAS" /> Chief of State<ref name="SWE" /> Organa Solo decided, in 11 ABY,<ref name="11 ABY" /> to send her Noghri bodyguards back home on [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]].<ref name="TJAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Several years had passed since, in the face of mounting pressure from the Council, Leia had eliminated her bodyguard of Noghri hunter-killers. Leia understood it; even before the unfortunate incident of the Barabel ambassador, there were those who said it ill behooved her to wield a weapon that had been Palpatine's.|Excerpt from ''Planet of Twilight''|<ref name="PoT" />}}
Inath was created in the [[1998]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] under the entry for Ralltiir, which mentioned the [[1997]] book ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'' by [[Barbara Hambly]] as a source.<ref name="SWE" />

This character was later mentioned in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' by [[Bill Slavicsek]],<ref name="AGSWU3" /> and also in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which was co-authored by Stephen J. Sansweet and [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|76|Ralltiir}}</ref>
